'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Matt Thornton DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matt Thorton
* '''Username:''' BrenDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
